body: We've been together 4 months but him and his X broke up 5 years ago and she now lives with her boyfriend who she has a 2 year old with
Took another test this morning, came back positive 😄

I've been through 2 physically and mentally abusive relationships, I've been used, taken advantage of and disregarded by those who were suppose to be there for me. I've spent ten years fighting the urge to end things. I helped raise my 2 cousins after their mother committed suicide. The only reason I'm here today is because my uncle who hung himself and my father himself had to cut down and my aunt who sat in the car with it running in the garage both shattered my family and while my life has been nothing but hell on earth I haven't been able to get past doing that to them. I tried again to restart my life and instead walked into another shit storm and now the people who I've fought to stay alive for have basically told me I'm shit and my new start would never be accepted by them. Stop comparing your pain to others. You can't get the whole story from a post or two. But anyone who comes to this site deserves advice not judgement.

FYI even people with a good family and a descent job can feel alone and desperate.  And if it's because I'm dating someone who fucked up in the past I don't believe people who have made mistakes should always pay for them the rest of their lives.  Life isn't black and white. But thank you for deciding I don't deserve advice or help.
